item.text: {"search_note":"I found limited direct evidence on day-to-day empowerment inside the economic ministries. The public record is mostly indirect: cabinet names, market reactions, and performance outcomes. I did not find strong sourced evidence in 2024 of Jokowi putting family members into core economic posts, but I also did not find evidence that key economic decisions were insulated from political loyalty or transition bargaining.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient","summary":"The World Bank said Indonesia’s solid macro framework helped attract investment and that continued prudent, credible, transparent policy was needed to sustain broad-based growth.
